titulo_ja: ところ の じかん
titulo_es: Before, during and just after with

texto: The verbal form prior to the time of the action is fixed. The verbal form before the action can also introduce an discovered result when testing something.
(I am just now reading the document.)

frases.ja: いま から しょくじ を する ところ です。

frases.es: Justo ahora estoy leyendo el documento.
frases.en: Right now I'm reading the document.
